name: io.github.Nizoka/pdfnative-mcp
description: Production-grade MCP server for PDF generation, PDF/A archival, PDF/UA structural validation, digital signatures (PAdES sign + verify, constant-time node:crypto), page-tree ops (merge / split / extract), Factur-X invoices, and PDF introspection. 17 tools, 24 scripts, zero runtime dependencies beyond pdfnative and the MCP SDK.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDF outputs. When unset, every tool returns base64.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory. SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bind to an HTTP port instead of stdio (Streamable HTTP MCP transport).
